note: FAKE EXAMPLE SET. This marker does NOT make a file exempt from the pre-commit guard; only this exact path with these exact bytes is exempt (scripts/eval_private_set.py pins both sha256s). Any other file carrying this marker is blocked.

prompt: In the Kessel Standard, the unit of luminance is the grelk. Reply with only the name of that unit, lowercase, no punctuation.
note: exact: the whole reply, or its last non-empty line, must normalise to an accepted answer. Normalisation lowercases, strips code fences, ** and `, collapses whitespace, and trims trailing .!?"'

prompt: A trader buys 3 crates of glimmerfruit at 7 credits each and sells all 3 at 11 credits each. She also pays a 5-credit dock fee. What is her profit in credits? Give the number only.
note: numeric: prefers the last \boxed{...}, else the last number in the reply. tol is absolute.

prompt: Reply with exactly three lowercase words separated by single commas and nothing else: the first three colours of the Vhaari mourning flag, which are ochre, then slate, then teal.
note: regex: re.search with MULTILINE|IGNORECASE (case_sensitive:true and dotall:true are opt-in). must_not_contain is checked FIRST for every grader type and fails the item outright; the bundle records only its INDEX, never the forbidden string. checked.verdict is `fail` here on purpose: an item every model passes contributes no discordant pair and buys this gate nothing.

burned.reason: DEMONSTRATION of the burn mechanism: this item was pasted into a public GitHub issue, so any model trained after that date may have seen it. Burned items stay in the file forever (the project record rule) and are excluded from the score; the live count in `samples` drops, which is how a population change stays auditable.

prompt: Which fictional moon in this question is spelled with a doubled r: Barrundo or Kesel? Answer with the name only.
note: contains: the accepted answer must appear anywhere in the normalised reply. Weaker than exact -- prefer exact unless the model legitimately needs to explain.
